summary: Operator site + its Hipcamp booking page: the two RV/tent sites are from $50/night (4 guests), no electric, vehicles under 30 ft; changed fees 36-43 (tent-only sites) -> 50 base. Added 24 sites (2 take RVs), showers/potable water, reservable on Hipcamp. Not stated: season (a 'three-season' retreat; cafe late April-early November), water/sewer at site, max stay.
flags: Price gate: base $50/night (the only RV-capable sites, from $50 for 4 guests on Hipcamp), exactly at the US$50 line, not over it. No gateway within 40 km (nearest Shenandoah NP 53 km); the family has not stayed here.
Missing phone: the operator's site gives 202-422-7540 (304-359-4884 text only).

Only 2 of the 24 sites take an RV, both creekside with no hookups and 'Vehicles under 30 ft'; Site 30's RV parks 'right next to the site in the parking area'. Hipcamp lists 280 reviews; the operator's own site has a working camping page and phone, so the presence rule is met.
